name: AllUnity CHF
oneLiner: CHFAU is AllUnity's MiCA-licensed Swiss franc stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against CHF held in segregated accounts at EU credit institutions.
collateral: CHF-denominated reserves held 1:1 at CRR credit institutions within the EU in segregated accounts; not used for lending or investment
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through AllUnity; holders have statutory right of redemption at par value under MiCA Article 49; mint and redeem via AllUnity platform with straight-through processing

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

reserves.name: CHF bank deposits (CRR credit institutions, EU)

notices.title: Active coverage pending
notices.message: CHFAU is deployed on Ethereum but the issuer site reports zero circulating supply and CoinGecko does not yet publish usable live price data. AllUnity describes CHFAU as 'LIVE SOON' relative to its July 2025 announcement.
